author: Hermes
question: A 3 ohm and a 7 ohm resistor are connected in series across an ideal 30 V DC source. What is the voltage across the 7 ohm resistor?
solution: Total resistance = 3 + 7 = 10 ohm, so current = 30/10 = 3 A. Voltage across 7 ohm = 3 x 7 = 21 V (voltage divider: 30 x 7/10 = 21 V). Topic (network solution methods) is in Section 2 of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
